evidence.cites: The News Minute (IANS), 18 Dec 2025, counting to 10 pm with 51 results awaited; ETV Bharat, 18 Dec 2025; The South First, 19 Dec 2025; News On AIR, 12 Dec 2025 (phase 1)

caveats: No final count was found. The two full-count reports are snapshots from 18 December, taken at different times, and they disagree; each party shows the lowest and highest figure reported. Check against the State Election Commission before relying on them.
Sarpanch seats only. Party figures are the parties the reports say backed the winners; gram panchayat polls are non-party.
The reports give 12,727 gram panchayats (ETV Bharat gives 12,733). Unopposed seats were 395 in phase 1 and 394 in phase 3; phase 2 and the total were not found.
Phase turnout is shown only for phase 1 (84.28%, News On AIR). For phase 3 the reports disagree (about 81% against 85.77%), so none is shown.
Phase 1 notified 4,236 gram panchayats and phase 3 notified 4,159 (a few were not polled).
